scope: User-requested complete saved-state weight footprint, unmerged; no new model or quality experiment.
accounting: Full model parameters plus necessary weight bases/masks and CL anchors/task weights; deduplicated by actual archive storage. Derived positional/rotary caches, activations, training history, processor/RNG and container metadata excluded and reported separately.
representation: Actual original saved-state precision and representation; no folding, quantization, conversion, tensor loading, model execution or archive callable execution.
byte_definition: MiB=1048576 bytes. Increment=final required saved weights minus the existing same-backbone original pretrained tensor bytes. Precision and representation changes contribute; increment does not mean new trainable coordinates.
current_integrity_scope: Current ZIP metadata and entry sizes are bound to original accepted checkpoint SHA/latest metadata/file size; original raw weight payload values were not rehashed.
